additions.site_name: Forbes International Tower, New Administrative Capital
additions.name: Pinnacle Data Center at Forbes International Tower

status.summary: On November 11, Egypt’s Ministry of Planning and Economic Development reported an agreement to develop a data centre inside the proposed Forbes International Tower in the New Administrative Capital.

locator.precision: Named place point for the planned Forbes International Tower property in the New Administrative Capital.
locator.identity_review: The project partners and ministry identify Forbes International Tower as the host. The native place links to the developer’s tower website and identifies the same Central Business District. Its position agrees with the host marked on the developer’s site plan.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The named point represents the proposed commercial tower property. The source gives no surveyed positional accuracy or location within the tower.

additions.distinctness_review: The planned facility is inside the proposed Forbes International Tower. The nearest baseline property, Telecom Egypt RDH2 Smart Village Campus, is 64.7 km away. The developer’s contact office is in New Cairo and has a separate address.
additions.successor_review: The participants’ November 12 release also describes a proposed data centre within the tower. Subsequent coverage reviewed through November 26 concerns the same agreement. The announcement establishes neither a construction milestone nor an opening.

additions.name: KIO QRO1, El Marqués

status.summary: KIO identified QRO1 as one of its two operating El Marqués data centers.

additions.site_identity_review: KIO places both operating centers at the same El Marqués address and describes QRO3 separately as a proposed campus project.

locator.identity_review: The property is the shared commercial campus that KIO identifies for QRO1 and QRO2. The existing reference point represents this campus.

additions.distinctness_review: QRO1 has its own operator property page and is listed separately from the other operating center in the October response. The pre-existing QRO3 entry represents a proposal.
additions.successor_review: The operating statement identifies the existing facility in October 2026. QRO3 is a separately proposed expansion.

status.summary: KIO identified QRO2 as one of its two operating El Marqués data centers.

additions.site_identity_review: KIO places both operating centers at the same El Marqués address and describes QRO3 separately as a proposed campus project.

locator.identity_review: The property is the shared commercial campus that KIO identifies for QRO1 and QRO2. The existing reference point represents this campus.

additions.distinctness_review: QRO2 has its own operator property page and is listed separately from the other operating center in the October response. The pre-existing QRO3 entry represents a proposal.
additions.successor_review: The operating statement identifies the existing facility in October 2026. QRO3 is a separately proposed expansion.

additions.name: Ascenty QRO01, Colón

status.summary: Ascenty reported the operation of its QRO01 data center in Querétaro.

locator.method: Midpoint of the named OSM property’s WGS84 bounding box, rounded to six decimal places.
locator.precision: Representative point for the named QRO01 commercial property in Vesta Park.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The map feature has no published surveyed horizontal accuracy.
locator.identity_review: Ascenty’s QRO1 brochure and Digital Realty’s MEX01 listing give the same Nativitas address. The issuer names QRO01 in Vesta Park and the municipality independently identifies the Ascenty property at the same Vesta street number. The OSM feature names the operator and facility number.

additions.distinctness_review: QRO01 and QRO02 are separate Ascenty properties in Colón. The existing KIO project and its two operating facilities in El Marqués belong to a different operator and industrial park. No Ascenty Querétaro property appears in the baseline.
additions.successor_review: The October 2026 company response names its operating QRO01 site. The brochure separately identifies Querétaro 2 and Querétaro 3.

additions.site_name: Felicity IDC, Solaris South Wing, Kaliakair Hi-Tech Park
additions.name: Felicity IDC Kaliakair, existing colocation operations

status.summary: On November 10 the ISC2 Dhaka Chapter identified Felicity IDC as the operator of the carrier-neutral data centre at Kaliakair Hi-Tech Park.

locator.method: Area-weighted centroid of the named OpenStreetMap commercial data-centre property, way 992650497 version 3.
locator.precision: Representative point for the Bangladesh Technosity commercial property that hosts Solaris South Wing. The polygon covers the host property.
locator.identity_review: The operator and its corporate group place the data centre at Solaris South Wing. The group names Bangladesh Technosity as concessionaire. The mapped property bears that name and identifies an Internet data center. The operator’s independently published location falls inside the same polygon.
locator.uncertainty_reason: OpenStreetMap supplies no survey accuracy for the mapped commercial property.

additions.distinctness_review: Snapshot 203’s Bangladesh Data Center Company property in the same park is approximately one kilometre away. The operators and named properties are distinct. The November statement concerns the Felicity facility in Kaliakair.
additions.successor_review: The November 10 association statement identifies existing operation. Felicity’s own location page and its corporate group identify the same commercial facility at Solaris South Wing.

operating_model_updates.identity_review: KIO’s QRO1 property profile expressly markets the facility for wholesale deployments. Its commercial models page defines wholesale as colocation.
KIO’s QRO2 property profile expressly markets the facility for wholesale deployments. Its commercial models page defines wholesale as colocation.
Digital Realty’s MEX01 commercial offering lists Camino a Nativitas 800, matching Ascenty’s QRO01 property in its own brochure.
Fiber@Home identifies Felicity IDC’s carrier-neutral colocation business at Solaris South Wing, Block 3, in Kaliakair Hi-Tech Park.

The operator identifies colocation as one of the existing services at its Phnom Penh facility in the November 16 announcement. Its facility-specific colocation page gives the same Phnom Penh City Centre street address.
Chaktomuk offers shared racks and private rooms to customers at its named site in Toul Sangke II, Phnom Penh.

The operator identifies EcoDataCenter 1 in Falun and describes serving colocation customers there on printed pages 12–13 of its 2025 sustainability report. The measurements refer to this operating campus.

annual_energy_observations.notes: The operator’s 2025 report gives 41,980,918 kWh of operational facility energy at Falun in 2024, including energy for IT and cooling. This uses the 2025 comparative, which revises the prior report’s total.
The operator’s 2025 report gives 112,544,997 kWh of operational facility energy at Falun in 2025, including energy for IT and cooling.

annual_water_observations.notes: Calendar 2025 water consumption for Ascenty QRO01 as reported by the operator. Purchased water was primarily for administrative and sanitary use.

EcoDataCenter reported total water withdrawal of 22,755 m³ at its Falun site in 2024.
